comments_data.body: Love the disappearing button once its been clicked on. Great work @lebaphi !

Small problems though. It seems it wasn't merged in the game:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/164535946-f93b5492-2c8a-47e6-a306-c474135eec6d.mp4

The chat message was sent twice. Furthermore, there are some issues with the chat envelope not being opened/closed correctly upon clicking, as you can see above.

Good morning @ShendMikullovci - Heroku had a security issue, and isn't accepting automatic deployments from GitHub right now. So, I'm afraid `serge-review` isn't being updated.  If it's not fixed in a couple of days we'll have to find another solution.

Sadly, the video walkthroughs are all you have right now.

> Sadly, the video walkthroughs are all you have right now.

In that case, it looks great!

issues.title: Mark All Read Removal
issues.body:
Given that we've added the mark all read button in most of the channels, I suggest we remove the older control: 

![Old Mark All Read](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/163008321-d84cb68d-07fd-4c7a-a008-e2989d21d1ed.png)

And we replace it with our icons: 

![Channel Icons](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/163008386-f344f5f8-7415-4973-9ee0-59d6d95fc854.png)

In cases where filtering and archive are not relevant, we don't include them. 

Let me know your thoughts.
